payload.claim: The spec declares `risk: standard`, but its `touches` include `saffron/ledger.py`, which is listed in this repo's own `.saffron/policy.yaml` `elevate_on` list. Per `DESIGN.md`'s risk-tiering rule, a diff touching an `elevate_on` path is auto-elevated to `risk: elevated` regardless of the declared tier, which makes the `size` gate blocking rather than advisory for this task. This is harmless here since the measured diff (478 tokens) is well under the 1300-token `bug` ceiling even at the blocking tier, but it is worth the operator knowing the task will actually run at elevated risk despite the frontmatter saying standard.
